nodes.label: FIX-001: front/.env Configured With Only Public VITE_* Vars
nodes.rationale: Ensures no backend secrets are copied into the frontend bundle, enforcing ADR-005.

nodes.label: FIX-004: Internal Metrics Endpoint Requires auth:sanctum + admin
nodes.rationale: The internal metrics endpoint was previously accessible without admin authentication; guarded to prevent unauthorized operational data exposure.

nodes.label: SEC-001: Public Telemetry/Operational Endpoints
nodes.rationale: Endpoints like /api/dashboard/public, /api/sensors/{sensor}/latest-readings, /api/devices/{device}/sensors and /api/alerts/active remain unauthenticated for Blade-era compatibility; a third party with network access could read operational state. Recommendation: move to auth:sanctum once the SPA reliably sends Bearer tokens.

nodes.label: SEC-002: Global Legacy IoT API Key
nodes.rationale: Ingestion still accepts a global legacy API_KEY besides per-device keys; if leaked it could inject readings into any active sensor. Recommendation: rely on per-device keys and retire the global key.

nodes.label: SEC-003: Bearer Token in localStorage
nodes.rationale: XSS in the frontend could extract the Bearer token; recommendation is to harden CSP and evaluate migrating to Sanctum HttpOnly cookie once the SPA is stable.

nodes.label: SEC-004: SMTP Password Stored as System Setting
nodes.rationale: SMTP password is never returned via API but is stored in system_settings; direct DB access would expose it. Recommendation: encrypt sensitive SystemSetting values or move them to environment/secret manager.

nodes.label: SEC-005: Testing APP_KEY Committed in .env.testing
nodes.rationale: Low impact if only used for tests; must never be reused in staging/production.
